cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)


project(Skirnir LANGUAGES CXX VERSION 0.16.1)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 26)

option(SKIRNIR_USE_FMT "Use the fmt library for logging" OFF)

# When ON (default), the hot-swap library is compiled into the skirnir
# target. The library uses compile_commands.json generated by CMake to drive
# recompilation at runtime. The Hotswapper can be disabled at the call site
# by defining SKR_DISABLE_HOTSWAP.
option(SKIRNIR_DISABLE_HOTSWAP "Disable the embedded hot-swap runtime" OFF)

if(NOT TARGET skirnir)

  include(FetchContent)

  file(GLOB_RECURSE SKIRNIR_SRC src/**.cpp)

  add_library(skirnir ${SKIRNIR_SRC})

  add_library(skirnir::skirnir ALIAS skirnir)

  # Hot-swapped plugins are shared libraries that link against skirnir; the
  # static archive must therefore be built as PIC.
  set_target_properties(skirnir PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

  target_compile_definitions(skirnir PUBLIC -DSKIRNIR_USE_SIMDJSON)

  if(NOT ${SKIRNIR_DISABLE_HOTSWAP})
    if(WIN32)
      target_compile_definitions(skirnir PUBLIC SKR_HOTSWAP_PLATFORM_WIN32=1)
    else()
      target_compile_definitions(skirnir PUBLIC SKR_HOTSWAP_PLATFORM_UNIX=1)
      find_library(SKIRNIR_UUID_LIBRARY uuid REQUIRED)
      target_link_libraries(skirnir ${SKIRNIR_UUID_LIBRARY})
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(skirnir PUBLIC
      SKR_HOTSWAP_CXX_STANDARD=${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}
      SKR_HOTSWAP_ROOT_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
      SKR_HOTSWAP_BUILD_PATH="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}"
    )

    # Generate the compile_commands.json path header. When
    # CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS is ON, point at the binary directory's
    # compile_commands.json; otherwise leave it empty so callers must supply
    # a path explicitly via CompilerConfig::compileCommandsJson.
    if(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS)
      set(SKIRNIR_COMPILE_COMMANDS_JSON "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json")
    else()
      set(SKIRNIR_COMPILE_COMMANDS_JSON "")
    endif()
    configure_file(
      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/Skirnir/Hotswap/Private/CompileCommandsPath.hpp.in
      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/Skirnir/Hotswap/Private/CompileCommandsPath.hpp
      @ONLY
    )
    target_include_directories(skirnir PRIVATE
      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
  else()
    target_compile_definitions(skirnir PUBLIC SKR_DISABLE_HOTSWAP=1)
  endif()

  FetchContent_Declare(
    simdjson
    GIT_REPOSITORY "https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson.git"
    GIT_TAG "master"
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
  )
  set(SIMDJSON_DEVELOPER_MODE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_STATIC_LIB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_BENCHMARKS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(SIMDJSON_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  FetchContent_MakeAvailable(simdjson)

  target_link_libraries(skirnir simdjson::simdjson)
  target_include_directories(skirnir PRIVATE ${simdjson_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

  if(${SKIRNIR_USE_FMT})
    target_compile_definitions(skirnir PUBLIC -DSKIRNIR_USE_FMT)

    FetchContent_Declare(
      fmt
      GIT_REPOSITORY "https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt.git"
      GIT_TAG "12.1.0"
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(fmt)

    target_link_libraries(skirnir fmt::fmt)
  elseif(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX)
    target_link_libraries(skirnir stdc++exp)
  endif()
endif()

target_include_directories(skirnir PUBLIC include)

target_precompile_headers(skirnir PUBLIC <Skirnir/Common.hpp>)

if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
  target_compile_options(skirnir PUBLIC -freflection)
elseif(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
  target_compile_options(skirnir PUBLIC /experimental:reflection)
endif()

install(TARGETS skirnir)

install(DIRECTORY include/
  DESTINATION include
)

option(BUILD_SKIRNIR_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE)
option(BUILD_SKIRNIR_TESTS OFF CACHE)
option(BUILD_SKIRNIR_BENCH OFF CACHE)

if(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} STREQUAL ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})
  set(BUILD_SKIRNIR_EXAMPLES ON)
  set(BUILD_SKIRNIR_TESTS ON)
  set(BUILD_SKIRNIR_BENCH ON)
endif()

if(${BUILD_SKIRNIR_EXAMPLES})
  add_subdirectory(examples)
endif()

if(${BUILD_SKIRNIR_TESTS})
  enable_testing()
  set(SKIRNIR_BUILD_BENCH ${BUILD_SKIRNIR_BENCH} CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(test)
endif()
